scientific_integrity: An analytic exact-moment proof establishes the unrestricted identities. Independent finite enumeration and rational recurrence checks are corroborative only. All accessible text is assessed against distinct random-tree models.
scientific_limitations: Uniform rooted recursive trees with terminal vertices defined by zero outdegree; a parent with multiple terminal children contributes all unordered pairs. No claim of stochastic dominance, general growth-model universality, or independent historical priority confirmation. The original full text of the 2004 Janson article could not be retrieved during this review.
title: Exact terminal-sibling covariance and a constant regression slope in random recursive trees
